required_fields: Clinical phenotypes reported in individuals with Popov-Chang syndrome (OMIM #618428, YWHAZ variants)
Phenotype frequency given as numerator and denominator per cohort (not percentage alone), with source cohort and PMID or DOI
Phenotype description as worded in the original paper plus corresponding standard HPO term if identifiable
Most discriminating findings (present in most affected individuals but uncommon in differential diagnoses)
Names of overlapping disorders usually confused with Popov-Chang syndrome and confidence assessment of the distinction
Phenotypic findings looked for and found absent in affected individuals (findings that argue against the diagnosis)
Differences in phenotype by variant type, variant position, age, or sex
Findings reported in one paper and explicitly contradicted by another
